items.briefing:
Australian ed-tech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting over one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information was exposed, making this directly relevant to schools and training organisations across Australia that may use the platform. If your organisation works with Mathspace, check whether you or your students are affected and watch for suspicious emails using that personal data.

Separately, AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing and harder to detect. Staff should be extra cautious with unexpected messages, even if they seem personal or professional in tone. **Tip:** If you receive an urgent or unusual request by email or phone, verify it through a separate, known contact method before acting.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
